policy.entryRule: Deploy ~50% of available Agentic cash on confirmed bottoming
policy.haltRule: -12% from weighted-average deployed cost pauses new buying (pause-and-review, no auto-sell)
policy.approval: Every order requires Jun's explicit authorization. No resting broker order.

zone.note: Weekend estimate. Must be revalidated against live Monday data before use as a trigger.

sizing.note: Gateway watcher writes Agentic available cash. Next tranche = availableCash * deployFraction; shares computed from live price only when fresh.

order.detail: No order open, staged, or resting.

reviewStamp.note: C posts an independent verification stamp here; it binds to the data fingerprint and expires on any fingerprint or freshness change.

staleReason: No live watcher observation has been recorded yet (observedAt is null).
